thread.title: Investigate Financial Records

content.text:
> **Investigate pre-9/11 options trading, WTC insurance proceeds and post-attack contractor finances using original records.**
>
> Build on the existing investigation rather than starting from secondary summaries:
>
> - [Options research](/Users/admin/docs/911-worktrees/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/research/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/financial-records-2026-10-26/OPTIONS-REPORT.md)
> - [Insurance research](/Users/admin/docs/911-worktrees/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/research/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/financial-records-2026-10-26/INSURANCE-REPORT.md)
> - [Corporate and contractor research](/Users/admin/docs/911-worktrees/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/research/broader-evidence-review-2026-10-26/financial-records-2026-10-26/CORPORATE-REPORT.md)
> - [Public developing theory and source integration](https://github.com/AveLyra/911-conspiracy-investigation/blob/main/investigation/cross-chat-evidence-integration-2026-11-10/README.md)
>
> **1. Options trading and ownership.** Locate the most original available records for AMR/American and UAL/United options traded September 5–10, 2001: exchange and clearing records, contract-level volume and open interest, order timestamps, beneficial-owner information, trader interviews, complete positions and hedges, SEC/FBI analyses, and the dated airline newsletter and distribution records cited by investigators. Trace the identity and economic exposure of the trader or traders behind the principal transactions where public records permit.
>
> Examine Poteshman’s study and any other relevant peer-reviewed analyses. Specify the comparison population, dates, statistics, selection effects and alternative benchmarks. Distinguish a percentile or p-value from a probability that a trader had attack foreknowledge. Say which calculations can be independently reproduced and which require data or code not obtained. Test the reported ordinary-strategy and portfolio-loss explanations against the strongest available records.
>
> **2. Silverstein and WTC insurance.** Locate the executed leases and amendments, preattack binders and insurance forms, financing and lender requirements, court judgments, insurer-specific settlements, recovery and allocation records, rent and debt obligations, rebuilding expenditures, and distributions to owners or other beneficiaries. Reconcile the amounts insured, claimed, awarded, settled and actually paid. Distinguish gross recovery from costs and personal net benefit. Preserve disputed dates or terms rather than silently resolving them. Test whether particular coverage or amendments were unusual relative to the lease requirements and contemporaneous commercial practice.
>
> **3. Contractors and other beneficiaries.** Trace Halliburton/KBR planning orders, award justifications, task orders, obligations, actual payments, costs, award fees, audits and profit where identifiable. Separately trace Carlyle-related ownership, fees, fund investments, exits and distributions where original records permit. Distinguish corporate revenue, contract ceilings, government obligations, questioned costs and verified profit. Identify any authenticated **pre-attack** transaction, instruction or communication connecting a beneficiary to attack arrangements; do not infer advance knowledge from subsequent benefit.
>
> **Deliverables:**
>
> 1. A dated chronology and source table with exact page or exhibit references, document custody and links.
> 2. A claim-by-claim table separating observations, statistical results, investigative conclusions, inferences, alternatives and unknowns.
> 3. A comparison of evidence that strengthens and weakens each proposed connection in the working theory.
> 4. A prioritized list of missing original records, likely custodians and the specific question each could resolve.
> 5. Proposed updates to the developing theory and master list. Clearly mark them as proposals unless you have authority and access to edit the actual repository.
>
> Preserve the distinction between a **compartmented hypothesis** and direct contact: the theory does not require UMS personnel to have communicated with the hijackers. Do not treat repeated summaries as independent evidence. Record unsuccessful searches, access restrictions, uncertainty about beneficial ownership, and the strongest disconfirming evidence. Do not contact people, submit FOIA requests, incur fees or publish private records as part of this research.
